issues.description: Duplicate React import in step-3/page.tsx causes module build failure. 'useState' and 'useEffect' are defined twice due to two separate import statements from 'react'.
issues.root_cause: The file has two import lines from 'react': line 2 imports { useState, useEffect } and line 3 imports { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef }. This causes SWC compiler to throw a redefinition error, breaking the build for step-3.

issues.description: Multiple React hydration errors on the dashboard page. Text content mismatch between server-rendered HTML and client-side render, likely caused by time-dependent content (e.g., 'Good evening, Amelia.' greeting which depends on time of day).
issues.root_cause: The greeting 'Good evening, Amelia.' is computed based on current time. Server renders at one time, client hydrates at a slightly different moment or with different locale, causing mismatch. This needs suppressHydrationWarning or useEffect to set the greeting client-side only.

fixes.new_str:
"use client"
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
fixes.reason: Removes the duplicate first import line that was causing SWC redefinition build error for useState and useEffect.
